svg.text: Coin cell LED on a perfboard
top view – component side, A1 at the top left
Lochraster, a pad per hole, 14 × 15 holes (35.6 × 38.1 mm) – edakit perfboard
Parts as seen from above; insulated wires in their colour, entering the board at the dots. The bridges are in the bottom view.
LED: flat side = cathode, + = anode (long lead). + and −: the ends of a holder or connector.
